title_en: The investigation team of the 43rd Division arrested suspects in a shooting incident at Or Sor volunteer Thung Yang Daeng, Satchara border post.
summary_en: The investigation team of the 43rd Division arrested suspects in a shooting incident at Or Sor volunteer Thung Yang Daeng, Satchara border post. They were taken to interrogation centre and are being prosecuted for security violations on the southern border on June 6th.
